plain_text:
Parks, Recreation & Harbor Advisory Committee 
Council Chambers  
Bangor City Hall 
July 9, 2026    5:15pm 
 
Welcome & Introduction: 
Members Present:  Ryan Robbins Jennifer Potter, Brianna Fry, Michaela Pelkey 
          Susan Faloon City Councilor, Pamula Kropp Anderson, Suzette Holly Furrow 
 
Staff Present: Tracy Willette - Parks & Recreation (Director) 
   Ben Arruda – City of Bangor Urban Forestry (Manager)  
 
Mission Statement Discussion: 
The committee discussed refining the department's mission statement. After discussing 
terminology—specifically the use of "stewardship"—the committee reached a consensus on the 
following phrasing: 
"Bangor Parks and Recreation is dedicated to strengthening community connections and 
civic pride through safe, accessible and diverse recreational opportunities that promote 
lifelong enjoyment, well-being while protecting Bangor's natural resources."      
 
Brown Woods and Essex Woods Master Plans:  
 Ben Arruda – City of Bangor Urban Forestry (Manager)  
 
Overview of the Brown Woods Management Plan and discussed the status of the Essex 
Woods plan  
Key points: 
• Management plans are developed for 10-year cycles  
  These properties do not utilize commercial timber harvesting; the focus is on  
  forest health, safety, and recreational utility  
• Essex Woods is a multifunctional site featuring a dog park, mountain bike trails, and 
 birding habitats  
 
Old Business and Updates: 
Trail Etiquette: The committee discussed potential signage to educate trail users on yielding to 
horses and other pedestrians  
Mansfield Stadium: Additional funding was approved for upgrading the original 1992 lighting 
fixtures to LED  
Park Signage: There was a discussion about updating park signs to include information regarding 
drug-free zones and littering ordinances  
Dog Park: An update was provided on the volunteer committee’s efforts to fundraise for a gazebo 
and training equipment  
Community Events: The recent free movie night was noted as a successful event with nearly 
700 attendees  
 
Adjournment: 
The committee decided to skip the August meeting and will regroup on September 10th, 2026
